outcome: Penicillin G concentration in amniotic fluid
Penicillin G concentration in cord blood
cohort: 60 GBS carriers in active labor after a singleton pregnancy of 37 weeks or more
finding: Four hours of intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis (IAP) reduced the number of women with positive GBS cultures to 12% and achieved penicillin G concentrations above the minimum inhibitory concentration in both amniotic fluid and cord blood.
